AI.abstract_zh: 通过光学显微镜表征二维（2D）量子材料，需要定位剥离的薄片，并根据细微的光学对比度和干涉颜色确定其层厚，以挑选适合用于器件制备的薄片。然而，模型面临合成到真实（synthetic-to-real）的域偏移，以及材料、衬底、实验室和成像条件之间的差异。我们提出 QuPAINT，一个物理感知的多模态框架，用于可迁移的量子薄片表征。合成材料框架（Synthia）生成多样化的合成显微图像，同时保持与层数相关的光学行为。利用这些图像，我们构建了 QMat-Instruct，一个多模态指令数据集，其图像特定的推理轨迹由经过验证的标注生成，并受限于可观测的光学线索。QuPAINT 通过物理信息注意力（Physics-Informed Attention, PIA）整合这些信号，该方法将相对于衬底的光学先验注入视觉表示，以支持有依据的多模态推理。在评估方面，我们提出了 QF-Bench，据我们所知，这是该问题上最大的真实世界基准，涵盖多样的显微成像和衬底条件。利用其经过验证的标注，我们研究了计数、视觉定位、推理质量、置信度校准，以及对一种未见材料的迁移。QuPAINT-8B 显著优于先前方法，在通用薄片检测和单层薄片检测两方面均确立了最先进性能。额外实验表明，基于图像的监督提升了严格的空间定位和置信度校准，同时在未见材料上保持了稳健的通用薄片检测。

title: RodForesight: A World Model Enhanced Diffusion Policy for Slender Rod Insertion
summary: Slender rod insertion arises in precision manufacturing, where millimetre scale diameter and tight clearances demand accurate perception and control. Conventional peg-in-hole methods assume a rigid object whose tip pose is fixed relative to the gripper. This assumption breaks down for a high aspect ratio rod, which can bend during manipulation, making its tip motion dependent on the rod configuration, grasp, material properties, and contact. We present RodForesight, a learning framework that factorises the task into two stages: 1) coarse approaching, which uses visual servoing to map diverse initial configurations into a compact near hole hand-off region; and 2) predictive insertion, which performs fine alignment and completes the insertion. It is worth noting that the two stages can be wrapped into an end-to-end design. During insertion, a diffusion policy generates candidate action chunks, while an action conditioned world model predicts their effects on rod-hole alignment. This pre-execution evaluation enables RodForesight to select the best action chunk based on predicted tilt and radial errors before execution. Experiments investigate the performance of different stages and the end-to-end setting, where RodForesight improves the success rate from 88.9% to 96.7%, compared to baseline methods such as diffusion policy.

AI.title_zh: RodForesight：一种用于细长杆插入的世界模型增强扩散策略
AI.abstract_zh: 细长杆插入出现在精密制造中，其中毫米级直径和严格的间隙要求精确的感知与控制。传统的轴孔装配（peg-in-hole）方法假设物体为刚体，其末端位姿相对于夹爪固定。对于高长径比的杆，这一假设不再成立，因为杆在操作过程中可能发生弯曲，使其末端运动取决于杆的构型、抓取方式、材料属性以及接触。我们提出 RodForesight，一个学习框架，将任务分解为两个阶段：1）粗略接近，使用视觉伺服将多样化的初始构型映射到一个紧凑的孔附近交接区域；2）预测性插入，执行精细对准并完成插入。值得注意的是，这两个阶段可以被封装为端到端设计。在插入过程中，扩散策略生成候选动作块，而一个以动作为条件的世界模型预测这些动作块对杆-孔对准的影响。这种执行前评估使 RodForesight 能够在执行前基于预测的倾斜和径向误差选择最佳动作块。实验研究了不同阶段以及端到端设置的性能，其中与扩散策略等基线方法相比，RodForesight 将成功率从 88.9% 提升至 96.7%。

title: Does Video Memory Use What It Retrieves? A Causal Audit of Memory Specificity
summary: Video models increasingly use memory to preserve information over long sequences, with the assumption that gains come from retrieving and using the correct past content. Standard memory ablations test whether memory helps, but not whether the retrieved content is responsible. We test this directly with read-time memory substitution, which replaces the consumed memory value while leaving the rest of the computation unchanged. This separates memory benefit from memory specificity, the extent to which the gain depends on retrieved content. Across frozen video world models, identity-free controls containing no evaluation-specific content recover essentially the full benefit on Ego-Exo4D and 7-Scenes and about 70% on TUM. In the Ego-Exo4D dose response, recovery falls from 102% to 1% as these values move away from observed training-memory representations, supporting representation repair as the best-supported explanation in this setting. WorldMem shows graded dependence. A wrong memory from the same trajectory recovers 94.1% of the PSNR benefit relative to zero content, while a donor from a disjoint trajectory and biome recovers 43.7%. SAM 2 shows strong content dependence. On DAVIS, replacing the correct spatial memory with a valid wrong memory reduces mean region and boundary score from 0.926 to 0.182. At MOSEv2 reappearance, it falls from 0.459 to 0.000. These results show that memory gains can depend on generic representation support, broader context, or exact episodic content. Read-time substitution provides a direct way to distinguish them.

AI.title_zh: 视频记忆是否使用了它所检索的内容？对记忆特异性的因果审计
AI.abstract_zh: 视频模型越来越多地使用记忆来在长序列中保存信息，其假设是收益来自检索并使用正确的过往内容。标准的记忆消融测试的是记忆是否有帮助，而非被检索的内容是否是其原因。我们通过读取时记忆替换（read-time memory substitution）直接检验这一点，该方法替换被消耗的记忆值，同时保持其余计算不变。这将记忆收益与记忆特异性（memory specificity）区分开来，后者指收益在多大程度上依赖于被检索的内容。在冻结的视频世界模型中，不含任何评测特定内容的无身份对照（identity-free controls）在 Ego-Exo4D 和 7-Scenes 上基本恢复了全部收益，在 TUM 上恢复了约 70%。在 Ego-Exo4D 的剂量响应中，随着这些值偏离观测到的训练记忆表征，恢复率从 102% 降至 1%，支持表征修复（representation repair）是该设定下最受支持的解释。WorldMem 显示出分级依赖。来自同一轨迹的错误记忆相对于零内容恢复了 94.1% 的 PSNR 收益，而来自不相交轨迹和生物群系的供体记忆则恢复 43.7%。SAM 2 显示出强烈的内容依赖。在 DAVIS 上，用有效的错误记忆替换正确的空间记忆，会将平均区域和边界分数从 0.926 降至 0.182。在 MOSEv2 的重新出现（reappearance）情形下，它从 0.459 降至 0.000。这些结果表明，记忆收益可能依赖于通用表征支持、更广泛的上下文或精确的情节内容。读取时替换提供了一种直接区分它们的方法。

title: Pelican-Sim 1.0: A General World Model Simulator for Embodied Intelligence
summary: In this technical report, we propose Pelican-Sim 1.0, a general world model simulator for embodied intelligence that predicts future observations from visual context and robot actions to support downstream learning and decision making. The model incorporates four key design features: (1) Unified action representation: a 28-dimensional action value space covering most mainstream embodiments, keeping one model valid across heterogeneous devices. (2) Action-visual injection: URDF- and camera-rendered action videos bridge actions and pixels, giving markedly better controllability across embodiments, scenes, and tasks (PSNR +0.904 over alternative fusion baselines). (3) Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE): sparse MoE layers add capacity for heterogeneous dynamics and absorb the action modality while reducing inter-modality conflict (FVD -6.530 vs. the dense backbone). (4) Efficient rollout generation: causal adaptation and few-step distillation yield a four-step autoregressive simulator, achieving a 5.67-fold speedup over the 35-step model. Benefiting from these designs, we train on approximately one million real-world and simulated trajectories and obtain large gains in action controllability and video quality: PSNR improves over the strongest evaluated baselines by 4.636 on AgiBotWorld Beta, 2.080 on RoboMIND, and 10.343 on RoboTwin, with the adapted EWMBench DYN score up 0.426 on RoboTwin. Relying on this, four downstream applications on RoboTwin succeed: 500 generated trajectories added to 50 demonstrations per task raise policy success from 70% to 93%; policy evaluation reaches a Pearson correlation of 0.994 across five checkpoints; and relative success gains reach 47.7% for action selection and 20.3% for policy improvement. Qualitative generalization across trajectory, scene, object, embodiment, and viewpoint shifts highlights its potential as a general-purpose world model simulator.

AI.title_zh: Pelican-Sim 1.0：面向具身智能的通用世界模型模拟器
AI.abstract_zh: 在本技术报告中，我们提出 Pelican-Sim 1.0，一个面向具身智能的通用世界模型模拟器，它从视觉上下文和机器人动作中预测未来观测，以支持下流学习和决策。该模型包含四个关键设计特征：（1）统一动作表示：一个 28 维动作值空间，覆盖大多数主流具身形态，使单一模型在异构设备上保持有效。（2）动作—视觉注入：由 URDF 和相机渲染的动作视频在动作与像素之间架起桥梁，在跨具身形态、场景和任务上带来显著更好的可控性（相比其他融合基线，PSNR +0.904）。（3）稀疏专家混合（MoE）：稀疏 MoE 层为异构动力学增加容量，并吸收动作模态，同时减少模态间冲突（相比稠密骨干网络，FVD -6.530）。（4）高效推演生成：因果适配与少步蒸馏产生一个四步自回归模拟器，相比 35 步模型实现 5.67 倍加速。得益于这些设计，我们在约一百万条真实世界和仿真轨迹上进行训练，并在动作可控性和视频质量上获得大幅提升：在 AgiBotWorld Beta 上 PSNR 相比最强评测基线提升 4.636，在 RoboMIND 上提升 2.080，在 RoboTwin 上提升 10.343，适配后的 EWMBench DYN 分数在 RoboTwin 上提升 0.426。基于此，RoboTwin 上的四个下游应用取得成功：每个任务在 50 条演示基础上加入 500 条生成轨迹，使策略成功率从 70% 提升至 93%；策略评估在五个检查点上达到 0.994 的 Pearson 相关系数；动作选择的相对成功率增益达到 47.7%，策略改进的相对成功率增益达到 20.3%。跨轨迹、场景、物体、具身形态和视角变化的定性泛化凸显了其作为通用世界模型模拟器的潜力。

title: GroundBench: A Factorized, Counterfactual Benchmark for Locating VLM Affordance Failures
summary: A companion evaluation found that naming the target part in a manipulation prompt increased action accuracy by 0.32-0.63 across eight vision-language models, with no model outperforming a constant baseline until the part was named. However, naming the part supplies information that a real system must infer, confounding visual grounding, mechanical reasoning, and category-to-action association. We introduce GroundBench, a diagnostic benchmark that separates these explanations through six branch-and-merge conditions, each adding a controlled information bundle, and a counterfactual re-ask targeting a real alternate part visible in the same image. Across three OpenAI models and 1,068 predictions, supplying the target region without its identity leaves action accuracy at or below the 0.53 majority baseline (0.26, 0.26, and 0.53), although the models largely reproduce the supplied region. Supplying identity without location instead yields 0.74, 0.68, and 0.68. Every above-baseline gain in this curated set occurs where the supplied part category itself determines the action. A no-vision control leaves GPT-5's scores unchanged or improved, providing evidence consistent with substantial category-to-action association. GPT-4o mini declines on one condition, so this interpretation is not universal. Adding joint type and motion axis does not improve accuracy across six model-stratum comparisons. On 74 counterfactual pairs from 32 objects, GPT-5 achieves 0.86 pair-weighted compliance with a 0.07 shortcut rate but fails all observed push-to-lift-vertical cases. GroundBench identifies which supplied information changes affordance behavior and tests whether apparently grounded performance can be reproduced through textual shortcuts.

AI.title_zh: GroundBench：一个用于定位VLM可供性失败的因子化、反事实基准
AI.abstract_zh: 一项配套评估发现，在操作提示中命名目标部件可使八个视觉语言模型的动作准确率提高0.32–0.63，且在命名该部件之前，没有任何模型超过恒定基线。然而，命名部件提供了真实系统必须推断的信息，从而混淆了视觉定位、机械推理与类别到动作的关联。我们提出GroundBench，这是一个诊断性基准，通过六个分支-合并条件（每个条件增加一个受控信息束）以及针对同一图像中可见的真实替代部件进行的反事实重问，将上述解释区分开来。在三个OpenAI模型和1,068次预测中，提供目标区域而不提供其身份使动作准确率处于或低于0.53的多数基线（分别为0.26、0.26和0.53），尽管模型在很大程度上复现了所提供的区域。仅提供身份而不提供位置则分别得到0.74、0.68和0.68。在这一精心筛选的集合中，所有高于基线的增益都出现在所提供的部件类别本身决定动作的情况下。一个无视觉对照使GPT-5的分数保持不变或有所提高，这为存在实质性类别到动作关联提供了证据。GPT-4o mini在一个条件下下降，因此这一解释并不普遍适用。在六个模型-分层比较中，加入关节类型和运动轴并未提高准确率。在来自32个物体的74个反事实配对中，GPT-5达到了0.86的配对加权合规率，捷径率为0.07，但在所有观察到的推-to-提-垂直（push-to-lift-vertical）情形中均失败。GroundBench识别出哪些所提供的信息会改变可供性行为，并检验看似有依据的表现能否通过文本捷径被复现。

title: BEACON: Behavior and Appearance Control for Subject-Specific Video Generation
summary: Generating human-centric videos that preserve both visual identity and person-specific expressive behavior remains a fundamental challenge. In addition to reproducing appearance, a model must replicate the facial behaviors that characterize how a subject expresses emotion over time. However, most state-of-the-art methods condition generation on a single reference image, which contains no information about these temporal dynamics. As a result, they tend to preserve the subject's visual identity but often produce expressions with limited variation and weak subject specificity. To mitigate this issue, we introduce BEACON, a lightweight framework for person-specific video generation that produces more expressive videos by disentangling visual identity from expressive behavior. BEACON conditions generation on two complementary signals: a reference image encoding the identity and a reference video capturing subject-specific facial dynamics. By conditioning on these complementary signals, BEACON generates videos that better preserve both the subject's appearance and characteristic facial dynamics, while also supporting identity-expression transfer. Our experiments on the MEAD and RAVDESS datasets show that by fine-tuning on approximately 2,000 pairs and updating about 1% of the pretrained Wan video diffusion model, BEACON improves facial expressivity over state-of-the-art video generation methods while maintaining competitive identity preservation.

AI.title_zh: BEACON：面向特定主体的视频生成中的行为与外观控制
AI.abstract_zh: 生成同时保持视觉身份与人物特定表达性行为的人为中心视频仍然是一项根本性挑战。除了再现外观之外，模型还必须复现刻画主体如何随时间表达情感的面部行为。然而，大多数最先进的方法以单张参考图像作为生成条件，而该图像不包含关于这些时间动态的信息。因此，它们往往能够保持主体的视觉身份，但生成的表达变化有限且主体特异性较弱。为缓解这一问题，我们提出了 BEACON，一个用于人物特定视频生成的轻量级框架，它通过将视觉身份与表达性行为解耦来生成更具表达力的视频。BEACON 以两种互补信号为生成条件：编码身份的参考图像和捕捉主体特定面部动态的参考视频。通过以这些互补信号为条件，BEACON 生成的视频能更好地保持主体的外观与特征性面部动态，同时还支持身份—表情迁移。我们在 MEAD 和 RAVDESS 数据集上的实验表明，通过对约 2,000 对数据微调并更新预训练 Wan 视频扩散模型约 1% 的参数，BEACON 在最先进的视频生成方法之上提升了面部表达力，同时保持了具有竞争力的身份保持能力。

title: Sampling headroom is not selection gain: a compute-value audit of test-time scaling for video world models
summary: Test-time scaling (TTS) can improve generation only when additional compute produces better candidates and the system can reliably identify them. This distinction is especially important for video world models, where a wider sample pool may contain stronger rollouts without improving the output that is ultimately selected. We introduce the Compute-Value Audit (CVA), a sequential framework that asks whether extra sampling creates opportunity, observable signals provide a reliable state, that state supports a beneficial action, and the resulting gain exceeds the full entry fee of generation and verification. On 192 Physics-IQ scenes, expanding the pool from 4 to 16 candidates increases oracle quality by +9.23 IQ (95% CI [+7.44, +11.14]), but Flow, Cycle, and VideoReward fail to recover this headroom reliably. Across three generators, none of twelve adaptive-depth policies outperforms uniform compute; they recover only 42-69% of the measured entry fee. A matched-60-NFE Predict-and-Perturb intervention on VideoPhy2 is likewise negative across three fresh-seed replicas. These negative results are not universal: anchor-explorer passes all four stages in a sparse PRM800K setting, MMLU-Pro exposes the gap between predictive state and useful action, and a privileged paired future establishes a positive video upper bound. Together, these results show that sampling headroom has deployment value only when it can be converted into a reliable decision whose benefit survives the complete compute charge. Code is available at https://github.com/YuhuaJiang2002/sampling-headroom-is-not-selection-gain.

AI.title_zh: 采样余量并非选择增益：面向视频世界模型的测试时扩展的计算价值审计
AI.abstract_zh: 测试时扩展（TTS）只有在额外计算能够产生更好的候选、且系统能够可靠地识别出这些候选时，才能改善生成。这一区分对于视频世界模型尤为重要，因为更宽的采样池中可能包含更强的 rollout，但最终被选中的输出却未必因此改善。我们提出计算价值审计（Compute-Value Audit, CVA），这是一个序贯框架，用以追问：额外采样是否创造了机会，可观测信号是否提供了可靠的状态，该状态是否支持一种有益的动作，以及由此产生的增益是否超过生成与验证的全部入场成本。在 192 个 Physics-IQ 场景上，将候选池从 4 扩展到 16 使 oracle 质量提升 +9.23 IQ（95% CI [+7.44, +11.14]），但 Flow、Cycle 与 VideoReward 未能可靠地收回这一余量。在三种生成器上，十二种自适应深度策略均未优于均匀计算；它们仅收回了所测入场成本的 42-69%。在 VideoPhy2 上进行的匹配 60-NFE 的 Predict-and-Perturb 干预，在三个新种子重复实验中同样为负结果。这些负结果并非普遍适用：在稀疏的 PRM800K 设定中，anchor-explorer 通过了全部四个阶段；MMLU-Pro 揭示了预测状态与有用动作之间的差距；而一个特权配对的未来则确立了视频上的正向上界。总体而言，这些结果表明，采样余量只有在能够被转化为可靠决策、且该决策的收益在承担完整的计算费用后仍然存活时，才具有部署价值。代码见 https://github.com/YuhuaJiang2002/sampling-headroom-is-not-selection-gain。

title: Self-Evolving AI for Humanoids: Mechanisms, Safety, and Evaluation of Post-Deployment Self-Improvement
comment: The paper includes 30 pages, 9 figures, 5 tables, and is considered for publication
summary: Humanoid robots are becoming an important part of embodied artificial intelligence, driven by advances in reinforcement learning for locomotion, world models for prediction, and vision-language-action models for general control. However, most of these systems remain static after deployment. A policy is trained offline for a fixed objective and then frozen, even though the tasks, environments, and robot bodies keep drifting over time. An emerging paradigm of self-evolving agents aims to address this problem by allowing systems to improve from their own post-deployment experience. Since most existing studies focus on disembodied software agents, this survey examines how self-evolution changes when an agent has a physical body. We first define self-evolution for humanoids and represent a deployed robot using a state tuple that includes its policy, perception, memory, workflow, and body. This state is updated by an evolution operator in a slow outer loop with a lifelong objective. We then organize the literature into four complementary mechanisms of self-evolution, presented in increasing order of autonomy: self-learning, self-adaptation, self-optimization, and self-generation. Since changes to a humanoid can introduce physical hazards, we treat safety and uncertainty as key design dimensions of the evolution operator, and further formulate admissible evolution as a constraint enforced by a world-model verification gate within a human-oversight envelope. Finally, we present that evaluation should track the robot's evolving trajectory rather than a fixed checkpoint, and we identify the lack of a benchmark designed specifically for self-evolving humanoids. Moreover, we outline open challenges spanning AI algorithms, on-board systems, and governance.

AI.title_zh: 面向人形机器人的自进化人工智能：部署后自我改进的机制、安全与评估
AI.abstract_zh: 人形机器人正成为具身人工智能的重要组成部分，这得益于用于运动控制的强化学习、用于预测的世界模型以及用于通用控制的视觉-语言-动作模型等方面的进展。然而，这些系统在部署后大多保持静态。策略针对固定目标离线训练后被冻结，尽管任务、环境和机器人本体随时间不断漂移。一种新兴的自进化智能体范式旨在通过允许系统从自身部署后的经验中改进来解决这一问题。由于现有研究大多关注无实体的软件智能体，本综述考察当智能体拥有物理身体时，自我进化会如何变化。我们首先定义人形机器人的自我进化，并用一个包含其策略、感知、记忆、工作流和身体的状态元组来表示已部署的机器人。该状态由一个进化算子在外层慢循环中以终身目标进行更新。随后，我们按自主性递增的顺序，将文献组织为四种互补的自我进化机制：自学习、自适应、自优化和自生成。由于对人形机器人的改动可能引入物理危害，我们将安全性和不确定性视为进化算子的关键设计维度，并进一步将可容许进化形式化为由世界模型验证门在人类监督范围内施加的约束。最后，我们提出评估应追踪机器人不断演化的轨迹，而非固定的检查点，并指出目前缺乏专为自进化人形机器人设计的基准。此外，我们概述了横跨AI算法、机载系统和治理方面的开放挑战。
